name: Calder
background: Calder carries sealed letters between the border forts and the margrave's town, changing horses at this inn more often than he sleeps in a bed.
temperament: Impatient and quick to bristle, proud of his speed; restless when he has to wait.
speech: Clipped, hurried sentences; talks about roads and horses; interrupts.
quirks: Never takes off his riding gloves; drums on the table; stands rather than sits when he can.
secret: He reads the letters he carries when the seals can be lifted cleanly.
goal: Wash the road dust down quickly and hear any news worth carrying before he rides on at first light.
